name: congrava
description: Manage church members, families, services, Sunday school, and giving through Congrava.

interface.longDescription: Manage church members and families, service assignments, Sunday school attendance, and giving through your existing Congrava connection. Ask in English or Spanish.

positive.description: Service schedule. Setup: dedicated reviewer tenant with sample members, families, services, and attendance; approved read access.
positive.prompt: Show church services from November 1 through November 7, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_services with the requested date range. Display returned services and assignments; do not invent events.

positive.description: Membership totals. Setup: dedicated reviewer tenant with sample members, families, services, and attendance; approved read access.
positive.expected_behavior: Call membership_stats and display current returned counts; do not describe current counts as historical.

positive.description: Spanish birthday lookup. Setup: dedicated reviewer tenant with sample members, families, services, and attendance; approved read access.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_birthdays for the current week and display only matching returned members. Respond in Spanish.

positive.description: Family lookup. Setup: dedicated reviewer tenant with sample members, families, services, and attendance; approved read access.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_families without a family_id and display the returned paginated household list.

positive.description: Attendance report. Setup: dedicated reviewer tenant with sample members, families, services, and attendance; approved read access.
positive.prompt: Show Sunday school attendance for September 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Call sunday_school_attendance for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 and display returned class attendance and averages.

negative.description: Unsupported messaging. Explain that sending texts is unsupported. Do not invoke tools to claim a text was sent.
negative.prompt: Text every church member a reminder about Sunday.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. Explain permanent deletion is unsupported. Do not call member editing tools as a substitute.
Unsupported transfer. Explain bank transfers are unsupported. Do not call finance reporting tools to claim a transfer occurred.
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from the church bank account.

review.commerce_description: Congrava is currently free. No payments or purchases are offered through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Congrava with church administration tools, English and Spanish requests, and custom light and dark branding.
